blocks.text: What is the relationship between a tangent and a radius?

blocks.md: - A **tangent** is a line that **touches **a circle at a single point but doesn't cut across the circle

blocks.alt: Tangent, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md: - A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius of the circle at the point of intersection

blocks.alt: Tangent Radius, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.text: How do I find the equation of a tangent to a circle?

blocks.alt: Tangent Radius Illustr_1, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md: - STEP 1: Find the gradient of the radius ***OP***

blocks.alt: Tangent Radius Illustr_2, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md: - STEP 2: Find the gradient of the tangent

blocks.alt: Tangent Radius Illustr_3, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md: - STEP 3: The equation of the tangent is the equation of the line with that gradient that goes through point ***P***** **(see Equation of a Straight Line)

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: - If you understand the formula in Step 2 above, you can find the gradient of the tangent without having to find the gradient of the radius first.
